SECTION 4 - PAEDIATRIC INTENSIVE CARE (ICU) FEES

ICU CONSULTATION FEES (PER DAY)

Initial visit:  $300 - $500  
Including:  IV line inserted, blood oxygen, Tenth Percutaneous Intubation (TPI), etc.  
Follow-up visit:  $200 - $300  
Basic monitoring and care, not critically ill.  
Daily management of critically ill patients, use of ventilator, cardiac output study, ICP monitoring, CRRT, ECMO can be included in "critically ill" fee. Consumables, including equipment, use medications can be charged separately.

PROCEDURAL FEES IN ICU

| Procedure                          | Fee           |
|----------------------------------|---------------|
| 2D Echo                          | $200 - $350   |
| Bronchoscopy                    | $200 - $350   |
| Central line or Long Line/ Dialysis Catheter Insertion/ Catheterisation or Intubation | $100 - $200   |
| Intrabosseous Access            | $150 - $160   |
| Chest tube Insertion/ Tap       | $75 - $100    |
| Lumbar Puncture                 | $50 - $90     |
| Ultrasound Head                 | $75 - $150    |
